verdict.rationale: Entra ID is an identity platform, so treating AI agents as first-class identities is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents agent identities, cross-app access, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials. General application-management controls (permissions, tokens, certificates) are adjacent features, not documented agent-identity patterns, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)
